name: Google Drive
author: VanillaGreen
description: Keep folders on this computer in step with Google Drive. VGS copies both ways every hour and never deletes a file.

requirements.purpose: Runs the sync and reads its status
Copies the files to and from Google Drive
Lets only one sync of a folder pair run at a time
Runs the sync every hour while you are logged in
Reads the Google Drive keys from the keyring
Tells you when the Google Drive sync needs you
Reads the name of the Google account you sign in with
Asks the setup questions in the setup window
Opens the Google sign-in page and the folders to review

reset-pairs.title: Start the folder pair list again

sync.label: Google Drive sync
sync.info: VGS copies each folder pair both ways. Newer files win. It never deletes a file. Older copies on this computer stay in the VGS sync records for 30 days. Older copies on Google Drive stay in the file version history for 30 days, up to 100 versions.

reset.label: Start the folder pair list again

keys.label: Keys
keys.hint: Get one OAuth client ID of type Desktop app from Google Cloud credentials
keys.info: Add the client ID and secret. Then select Connect. VGS stores every key in your keyring.

account.label: Google Drive
account.info: Connect lets VGS read and change files in your Google Drive. It copies only your folder pairs and never deletes a file.

connection.label: Google Drive connection
connection.hint: Connects VGS to Google Drive with the keys below
connection.info: Connect lets VGS read and change files in your Google Drive. It copies only your folder pairs and never deletes a file.

firstPair.label: First folder pair
firstPair.hint: Choose the first folders to keep on this computer and in Google Drive
